details.s: Celeborn was the Lord of Lothlórien and husband of Galadriel, Lady of the Golden Wood. He was said to be one of the wisest Elves in Middle-earth at the end of the Third Age.
f: Lord of Lothlórien, Lord of the Galadhrim, Lord of the Golden Wood, Lord of East Lórien, Prince of Doriath
Uncertain; possibly Years of the Trees
Sailed to Valinor in the early Fourth Age
